{{Otheruses|Battle of Onderon}}
{{Quote|Other fallen Jedi, not content to serve their comrades, struck out on their own, spreading the darkness. One such was Freedon Nadd. Nadd roamed the uncharted systems until he found a world he could dominate through the dark side. The planet was called&hellip;''"<br />"Onderon''.|Tedryn Holocron and Vodo-Siosk Baas|audio=Nadd1-DLotS.flac|<ref name="DLOTSA">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The self-proclaimed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="jvs">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> [[Freedon Nadd]] launched a '''coup''' against the ruling [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Nadd deposed the planet's existing monarchs and assumed the throne as [[King/Legends|king]].<ref name="DSSB">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref>
